# Aurorán

**Status: DRAFT** · world: [adrian](../lore/worlds/adrian.md) · kind: new · stage: space · id: `auroran`

## Niche

- **Habitat:** Upper stratosphere edge / wind shear zones

Lightweight, expansive membranous wings, silica-reinforced ribs, ventral photoreceptive patches
